title: Chapter 57 Aliens Enter The City
content:
Chapter 57 Aliens Enter The City

After careful consideration, the three-eyed man compromised and walked slowly to the city gate.

"I want to enter the city."

Zhang Hai stretched out his hand, "One million world crystals."

World crystals are the universal currency in the Wanling Realm.

Hearing this, the three-eyed man roared: "It takes one million world crystals to enter the city, why don't you go and rob?!"

"Two million world crystals!"

Zhang Hai said directly.

Suddenly, the three-eyed man was stunned, and then his killing intention was exposed.

"You,,"

At this time, the breath of the wild guard on the city wall came again.

He immediately wilted again.

"Can it be cheaper?"

"No."

Zhang Hai refused directly.

And at this moment, another figure slowly came from a distance.

It was seen that it was a human race.

"This, is this really the power of my human race?"

The human man came to the front of the deserted city, looking up at this supreme giant city, his expression full of respect and disbelief.

He couldn't imagine that there would be human forces in the Wanling Realm, and he couldn't imagine that this force would be so powerful.

Just standing at the foot of this huge city, he could clearly feel the supreme aura in the city.

Seeing this, Zhang Hai hurriedly ran over with a smile to help him.

"My compatriot, this is the power of our human race. From now on, our human race will no longer have to be timid in the Wanling Realm."

Hearing this, the man burst into tears.

"Human race, be prosperous!"

Then, the man directly entered the deserted city.

There was no obstruction.

Seeing this scene, the three-eyed tribe member on the side immediately roared: "Why doesn't that guy have to pay the entrance fee?!"

Hearing this, Zhang Hai sneered: "I am a human race, who are you?"

You are also worthy of comparing with the human race.

Seeing the racial discrimination in Zhang Hai's eyes, the three-eyed tribe member was directly stunned.

This was the first time he was discriminated against because of his race in the Wanling Realm.

In the past, he discriminated against the human race.

So, this is what it feels like to be discriminated against.

"Two million world crystals, get out if you don't pay."

At this time, Zhang Hai continued.

Hearing this, the three-eyed tribe member took a deep breath and gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, I'll pay."

He was sent by the tribe to gather intelligence.

If he can't even enter the city gate, he will definitely be punished when he returns.

It's okay to be blackmailed, at worst he can go back and claim reimbursement.

Then, with a look of heartache, he handed the storage ring with two million world crystals to Zhang Hai, and then successfully entered the deserted city.

Of course, it is definitely a profit to be able to enter the deserted city with these two million world crystals.

And after he entered, he soon discovered this.

Looking at the prosperous streets in front of him and the energy-rich environment, he, who has lived in the three-eyed tribe for half his life, sighed for the first time that the world is unfair.

Why is this place so luxurious?

Why is this not the territory of their three-eyed tribe?

Just as he was thinking, there was a whispering sound around him.

"Look, this guy actually has three eyes."

"It's so ugly."

"Sell it, will it sell for a good price?"

Hearing the discussions of the people around him, Sanhong was immediately furious.

Some of them actually treated him as a commodity, which was intolerable.

At this moment, he seemed to have forgotten that in the former Wanling Realm, they also liked to catch lone humans as commodities.

"How dare you!"

Boom!

Instantly, a pressure of the fourth level of the Earth Realm surged out from his body.

However, it was only a moment before it was suddenly suppressed by a mysterious force in the city.

At this time, he did not notice that the eyes of the people around him looking at him suddenly became a little pitiful.

But most of them were mocking.

Just when he was in doubt, a strong breath came from a distance.

The next moment, several guards wearing uniform robes and swords on their waists came here.

Huangwei.

And the leader was Ah Wei.

"It's over, this guy is finished, the leader of the Wilderness Guard actually went out in person."

At this time, Awei's strength was at the eighth level of the Earth Realm. Because most of the strength of the Wilderness Guards had not reached the average level of the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm, he could only go into battle in person.

However, this was just one of his clones.

Seeing Awei, Sanhong's pupils shrank slightly.

It's over, he met a master.

With just one glance, he knew that the other party was someone he couldn't afford to offend.

Sure enough, Awei's cold voice rang out from the field.

"What crime should you be charged for disrupting the order in the city?"

Hearing this, Sanhong suppressed his inner fear and said, "I, I am a member of the Three-Eyed Clan, and you human forces are not qualified to punish me."

Hearing this, Awei sneered, "Not qualified? Once you enter my Wilderness City, you will be under my jurisdiction, even if your clan leader comes."

"Catch him for me!"

Awei waved his hand and pointed, and Sanhong had no power to resist.

Just like that, he was taken away by the guards of the wasteland, and no one knew what would greet him.

At the same time, more and more creatures entered the wasteland city.

Among them, the human race was warmly welcomed by the people of the wasteland city.

The other races were like animals in the zoo, being watched by people.

However, not all of them were like that.

Some races with high appearance were also welcomed by some people.

For example, the elves with pointed ears and all handsome men and women.

Angels with snow-white wings on their backs, etc.

In a teahouse.

Chen Gui sat on the side and leisurely looked at these races of different shapes, thinking about something in his eyes.

If he could catch one of these and sell it, he would make a fortune.

However, he could only think about it.

Because he was only at the level of the Heavenly Emperor, and he didn't know how many years he would have to practice to catch a creature from the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

On the rooftop of Wanhua Tower.

Ji Shengcai and his wife were also watching the excitement below.

When he saw the beautiful elves and angels, an evil and bold idea came to Ji Shengcai's mind.

Seeing Ji Shengcai's evil smile, Mu Tianyin immediately pinched Ji Shengcai's waist.

"What are you thinking about again?"

"Hiss~ Ouch, wife, it hurts."

Ji Shengcai gasped in pain, and his thinking was immediately broken.

However, this idea was rooted in his heart.

Many residents of the inner city also came out in response to the bustle of the outer city.

Among them were the Nangong family and the Broken Sword Elder.

"Grandpa, what exactly does the city lord want to do by letting these aliens enter the city?"

Nangong Yu looked at these strange-looking aliens and couldn't help but frowned and asked.

Hearing this, Nangong Fang brushed his beard and said in a light voice: "Didn't the city lord say that our human race is in a weak position in this Wanling Realm, and many compatriots are in dire straits."

"This time, our Huangcheng came to the Wanling Realm, and as a human force, it is natural to let these foreign races see the strength of our human race and play a deterrent role."

Then, Nangong Fang's expression was slightly condensed.

"I boldly guess that this time, the city lord is likely to personally take action to deter some villains."

Hearing this, Nangong Yu suddenly nodded.

So that's it. On the side, the Broken Sword Elder and others also nodded in agreement.

As human beings, they naturally cannot sit idly by when the human race in the Myriad Spirits Realm is doing so badly.

However, the realm of the Myriad Spirits Realm is so high that they will have to retreat for a while.

Fortunately, there are sufficient resources in the city, and it is only a matter of time to cultivate to the corresponding realm of the Myriad Spirits Realm.

At this time, a terrifying breath suddenly came from outside the city.

The real big clan of the Myriad Spirits Realm is coming.
